unimplemented.enableHealing: No L0 heal-on-living verb yet. Do not toggle.
unimplemented.enableResurrection: L0-lab-0.6 keeps enableRevival false. Tutorial uses preventDeath instead.
unimplemented.majorUsesPD=false: L0 Majors always use PD → next-turn Altar. False would invent LEFT-to-Altar.
unimplemented.dialogueGeometry3to4p: 2p Dialogue is LEFT+MIDDLE; PD sits out. 3p/4p dormant geometry is not in L0.
unimplemented.aceSelect: Players do not pick an Ace. SETUP deals one random Ace into lineage. Character pick is later L1, not a 4-Ace menu.
unimplemented.eightLineages: L0 deals four Sun lines only (soft entry). L1 opens all eight.
unimplemented.evolveByColor: L0 stays same-lineage Ace→3→5. Secondary elemental / any-color growth is L1 (evolveByColor true).
unimplemented.twentyMajors: L0 does not deal the 20 Major Arcana. Jack/Queen/King of the four Sun lines are the L0 majors (PD → Altar, Eclipse).
unimplemented.eclipseOnTable: L0-lab-0.5+ Altar-only Eclipse. Court pair must be same face + opposite ink; pair is spent to Veil.
unimplemented.preventDeath: L0-lab-0.6 tutorial toggle: damage floors at 1 HP so the first session cannot party-wipe. Turn off to stress-test lethality.
